description: Wearing an elytra: glide from 10 blocks up, then use a firework rocket looking up (pitch -70): the client ticks the rocket attached to the player, which boosts it along its look while it glides. Then circle down turning 4 degrees a tick at pitch 15, using a second rocket on the way, until landing.

world.note: Fabric client gametest defaults: flat world, no structures, time and weather frozen, no mob spawning

build: item replace entity @a armor.chest with minecraft:elytra
item replace entity @a hotbar.0 with minecraft:firework_rocket 16
harness: Fabric client gametest: one client tick per frame, one server tick per client tick
